slides.h1: Run a TestFlight beta that teaches you something.
slides.lead: Most betas end with "looks good 👍". Here's how to get more.
Friends who'd never use your app will be nice. Nice isn't useful.
"Sign up and do the main action." A clear task beats "try it out".
Not "do you like it?" Everyone says yes. Confusion is the real feedback.
Where people quit tells you more than anything they write back.
Short rounds beat one giant beta that nobody finishes.

slides.h2: A beta isn't a launch. It's a lesson.
